card.name: Emission-reduction targets and baselines
card.fires_on: Words in news text about emission-cut goals, such as the percent sign, "below" or "targets" after a reduction figure. Also fires on comparison words like "since" and the year digits of a baseline like 1990.

modes.label: Cut amount and baseline
modes.description: The percent, "below" or year digits in a pledge to cut emissions against a base year.
modes.example: The goal was to decrease emissions 6 percent<< below>> 1990 levels.

modes.label: Other policy or comparison wording
modes.description: Words in health or economic news that frame a change against a past or other standard.
modes.example: the current generation of children could become the first generation of Americans<< to>> have shorter lives than their parents.
